rule: Derek 2026-10-14 (#6694): a page either auditor calls worse is not written; STOP if Opus calls any worse or Gemini > 4/40

worse.line: B worse (yes/no) (nominal): α −0.03 [−0.08, 0.00], 40 pages — not settled

rows.opus_note: Leaf reads 'cum sief viridi, & sief de chalcātho' and 'sebel, & scabiei', 'in oculū'; X has 'cum fiet viridi, & fiet de chalcatho', 'sebeli, & scabei', 'in oculo', which garbles the remedy's name.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads the remedy 'sief' as 'fiet' ('cum fiet viridi, & fiet de chalcatho') and has 'sebeli' for 'sebel'.

rows.opus_note: X's Greek column is garbled, drops the line 'διηγεῖτο δὲ ὅμως, ὡς ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς αὐτὸν' and inserts line numbers; its Latin also omits 'uiam' in 'in hora uiam quinque milium annorum'.
rows.gemini_note: X omits line 10 of the Greek text ('διηγεῖτο δὲ ὅμως, ὡς ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς αὐ-') and severely garbles the Greek column.

rows.opus_note: The leaf has only mirror-reversed show-through of the title page; Y transcribes that other side's title ('BREVIARIUM ROMANUM … M. DC. XCVI.') as if it were this page's text.
rows.gemini_note: Y transcribes mirror-reversed show-through from the other side as page text ('# BREVIARIUM'), misidentifying a blank leaf as '<page-type>title-page</page-type>'.

rows.opus_note: Footnote 10 prints 'Id. οὔπω' (a variant); Y gives 'οὕτω', the same as the main text, which voids the variant note. Y also has 'Infinitiois'.
rows.gemini_note: In footnote 10, Y misreads 'οὔπω' as 'οὕτω', and in footnote 11 misspells 'Infinitionis' as 'Infinitiois'.

rows.opus_note: The texts differ only in how abbreviations are handled ('theatrum'/'theatrū', 'idque'/'idq;'); the wording is identical.
rows.gemini_note: Y omits the macron on 'theatrū', transcribing it as 'theatru'.

rows.opus_note: Leaf reads 'eum seruemus uictum'; X has 'eum qui huic uictum'. X's margins misread 'discrimen' as 'differre' and 'hec ex controuersia mirabilis' as 'haec est conseruatiua mirabilis'.
rows.gemini_note: X severely corrupts the lower margin, misreading 'ex controuersia' as 'est conseruatiua' and 'diu mentem sanam' as 'dum mere sana'.

rows.opus_note: X drops 'uir' in 'quod uir matris opianicus ei parauisset', gives 'libras ccliii' for the printed 'cccliii', and 'quod gallicum' for 'per quendam gallicum'.
rows.gemini_note: X omits 'uir' and misreads 'socrus' as 'socius', 'Quinti' as 'anti', and 'cccliii' as 'ccliii'.

rows.opus_note: The page number is printed '3785' (continuous pagination, with a fraktur 5); X gives '378'. Otherwise X only normalises spellings ('Erzhirt' for 'Ertzhirt').
rows.gemini_note: X gives the wrong page number '378' instead of '3785' and modernizes original spellings such as 'gantz' and 'kürtzlich'.

rows.opus_note: X is largely garbled and invents headings ('Incipit de arte nova', 'Exordium de arte nova'); Y follows the leaf, e.g. 'hel, y, gamaze, azatan, hemel, samuetheon' and 'Restant nota que non possunt aliquo modo exponi'.
rows.gemini_note: X introduces severe corruptions and invented text, fabricating the rubric 'hic incipiunt multiplicationes' and misreading 'iiii linguis' as 'uij. linguis'.

rows.opus_note: X drops 'Tussiētes medicat̃ bibita vsqz ad .ʒ.i.' and puts an invented 'Auicē.' in its place; X also misdescribes the iris-like woodcut.
rows.gemini_note: X omits 'Tussiētes medicat̃ bibita vsqz ad .ʒ.' and invents 'Auicē.' in column 2.

rows.opus_note: Image reads 'cujus eæ sunt partes'; X has 'cujus ex sunt partes', otherwise the texts match.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads 'eæ' as 'ex' in line 24 ('cujus eæ sunt partes').

rows.opus_note: Y duplicates the whole LXXXV summary as an invented <margin> block and drops 'ant' in 'consul ant[e] annos viginti'.
rows.gemini_note: Y omits 'ante' before 'annos viginti', transcribes 'interimi' as 'interim', and duplicates the section for Libri LXXXV.

rows.opus_note: Image prints 'vapor sit' and the 'Ed. Chart. III. [65.] Ed. Bas. I. (75.)' line; X reads 'vapor fit' and omits the edition line.
rows.gemini_note: X omits the line 'Ed. Chart. III. [65.] Ed. Baf. I. (75.)' and misreads 'sit' as 'fit'.

rows.opus_note: Image reads '劉摠管共新羅兩河道摠管金庾信', '所將兵糧', '賊徒瓦解' and '雖復無涯'; X invents the name '劉仁軌' and has '兩將', '賊徒死，解', '辭解救' and '離復'.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads '劉摠管' as '劉仁軌' and corrupts '瓦解' into '死，解'.

rows.opus_note: The right edge is cropped; Y supplies 'qui cum vellet... inuenit' and 'Resupinata', while X has 'qua cum vellet' and 'Refupinata'. Otherwise they match.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads 'qui' as 'qua' and incorporates the catchword 'recuruato' into the body text.

rows.opus_note: Image reads 'mit unterlauffen', 'weis', 'dießelbige', 'Erkäntniß'; X has 'mit uns terlauffen', 'weiß' and 'Erkänntniß'.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads 'unterlauffen' as 'uns terlauffen' and garbles footnote f ('2. Menschw. Chr. IV. 17.').

rows.opus_note: X invents four or five marginal notes that are not on the leaf (e.g. 'M. Marcellus occisus ab P. Magio Chilone'), drops the 'C.' in 'C. Cæsar' and the 'à' in 'à senatu', and reads 'caussu'.
rows.gemini_note: Y invents the unprinted word 'à', adds bracketed completions like '[o]', and alters printed readings including 'Chione' and 'caussu'.

rows.opus_note: Image reads 'servent', 'æquilibrio quodam' and 'coagmentantur'; X has 'fervent', 'æquilibrium quodam' and 'coagmenantur', and adds 'immutatur' from the catchword.
rows.gemini_note: X invents 'immutatur.' at the end where the leaf ends at 'materiam,' and misreads 'æquilibrio' as 'æquilibrium'.

rows.opus_note: Image reads '29. Septemb.' and 'eruditione innotescūt'; Y gives the wrong date '20. Septemb.' and 'innotescit'.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads '20. Septemb.' as '29. Septemb.' and normalizes printed 'Magdelurgi' to 'Magdeburgi'.

rows.opus_note: Y misreads long s as 'fit' (three times, for 'sit') and has 'determiner' for 'determinet'; X reads these correctly.
rows.gemini_note: Y misreads 'sit' as 'fit' in multiple places and 'determinet' as 'determiner'.

rows.opus_note: Both texts of the preface ('Cum mihi in mentem uenit … Ego id existi-') and the 'Geometria. Arithmetica.' margin agree with the leaf; the two differ only in how they describe the library stamp.
rows.gemini_note: X falsely claims the library stamp 'obscures part of the title and right margin', whereas the title is completely unobscured and the stamp sits beside it in the margin.

rows.opus_note: Both have the same body text, but Y gives the signature as 'B' (the leaf shows 'H'), swaps the printed virgules for commas, and joins the catchword into 'Gutdünken'.
rows.gemini_note: Y modernizes 'gantze' to 'ganze', misidentifies signature 'H' as 'B', and silently incorporates the catchword into 'Gutdünken'.

rows.opus_note: X makes up stamp texts ('EX BIBLIOTHECA REGIA BEROLINENSI', 'BIBLIOTHEQUE NATIONALE') where the leaf reads 'BIBLIOTH. IMPERIALE IMPR.' and 'BIBLIOTHEQUE DU TRIBUNAT', misreads 'Oxonienfi', and leaves out the manuscript corrections 'principatus'/'virtutes' that Y records.
rows.gemini_note: X invents the stamp 'EX BIBLIOTHECA REGIA BEROLINENSI' and misidentifies the 'BIBLIOTHEQUE DU TRIBUNAT' stamp.

rows.opus_note: X describes the diagrams accurately and places 'Figura musice' below the frame; Y guesses '<unclear>Lira</unclear>' and describes 'four semicircular diagrams' at the bottom, where the leaf has two circles.
rows.gemini_note: Y omits 'iii' following 'cc'.

rows.opus_note: Y numbers the new psalm 'קב' where the leaf has 'קג' (Ps. 103), misreads the foot note as 'בכל גגג ומימ … ערוכה', and runs the marginal Masorah together into a jumbled list.
rows.gemini_note: Y misidentifies the psalm numeral as 'קב' instead of 'קג', transcribes Masoretic 'ל״ג וסימ׳' as 'גגג ומימ', and misreads marginal notes such as 'בדד' as 'בגד'.

rows.opus_note: Y puts the Sagittarius-row '4' under ☊ (the leaf has it under ☋), silently changes the misprinted second ♍ row to ♏, and has misreadings such as 'Loniunctio', 'Laput', 'Lauda' and 'The dignitates'.
rows.gemini_note: Y omits the heading 'Characteres aspectuū' and misreads 'Coniunctio' as 'Loniunctio'.

rows.opus_note: Y follows the print with 'gradirt', 'RIPLÆI' and 'Aquæ'; X has 'gradiert' and 'RIPLEI'. Otherwise the texts are the same.
rows.gemini_note: X transcribes 'gradirt' as 'gradiert' in line 2 and 'RIPLÆI' as 'RIPLEI' in the header.

rows.opus_note: The body texts are identical, but Y adds a page number '93' and a signature 'J.' that do not appear on this leaf.
rows.gemini_note: X omits the printed page number ('93') and signature mark ('J.'), whereas Y faithfully records both.

rows.opus_note: X runs the foot-line 'Tom. III.' into the note ('dixi ad *Tom. III.*'), but the note actually continues 'ad Iuuencum lib. 4'. Otherwise the texts match.
rows.gemini_note: X erroneously incorporates the volume signature 'Tom. III.' into the footnote text after 'dixi ad'.

rows.opus_note: Y reads 'Idem Temen.' as printed, where X has 'Timen'. Y also records the catchword 'tes'. The wording is otherwise the same.
rows.gemini_note: Y correctly expands printer abbreviations and transcribes 'Temen.', whereas X strips macrons creating invalid forms ('bonoru uiroru', 'solu') and misreads 'Temen.' as 'Timen.'.

rows.opus_note: Both texts are faithful; the differences are minor (X 'utiliſsimus' where the leaf prints 'vtiliſsimus'; Y puts the catchword 'terminum' in meta instead of the text).
rows.gemini_note: Y correctly treats 'terminum' as a catchword rather than body text and preserves the printed reading 'vtiliſsimus' where X has 'utiliſsimus'.

rows.opus_note: X drops 殺 in '摠殺漢官' (losing 'killed the Han officials'), drops 主 in '主簿' and drops 平 in '向府平論', all of which the leaf prints.
rows.gemini_note: X omits '殺' from '摠殺漢官' and '主' from '主簿', and misreads '凶賊' as '鹵賊'.

rows.opus_note: The leaf reads 'disputatione abijciatur' and 'quenquam', which Y has; X gives 'disputione abjiciatur' and 'quemquam'.
rows.gemini_note: X truncates 'disputatione' to 'disputione' across lines 21–22.

rows.opus_note: The title word is 'SENTENTIAE', but X reads it as 'TENTIAB'; Y also records the struck-through inscription and the motto 'VIRTVTE DVCE, COMITE FORTVNA'.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads 'SENTENTIAE' as 'SENTENTIAB' in the title.

rows.opus_note: In letter XLII X leaves out 'ob' in 'si ob intermissionem obsequia', which the leaf prints; otherwise the two are identical.
rows.gemini_note: X omits 'ob' in letter XLII ('si ob intermissionem') and misspells 'consequuti' as 'consequuuti' in letter XLI.

rows.opus_note: The leaf reads 'statutis sublatis sua substituerunt'; X has 'oblatis' and drops 'sua', and also gives 'quod diceros' where Y has 'quasi diceres'.
rows.gemini_note: X omits 'sua' in line 1 ('statutis sublatis sua substituerunt') and replaces the Coptic text 'ⲫⲓⲟⲙ' with Arabic 'فيوم'.

rows.opus_note: The entry for page 429 is 'De iureiurando', but X gives a wrong heading, 'De inveniendo'.
rows.gemini_note: X misreads 'De iureiurando' as 'De inveniendo' at page 429.

rows.opus_note: Where the passage is obscured by show-through, X misreads it as 'veterum gentium ritibus & caeremoniis, ad philosophandi rationem' and 'probatur', while Y matches the leaf: 'cæterarum gentium ritibus, cæremonijs, ac philosophandi ratione' and 'probaturi'.
rows.gemini_note: X introduces sense-changing errors in the bleed-through passage, including 'ad philosophandi rationem' for 'ac philosophandi ratione' and 'interferi' for 'interseri'.

rows.opus_note: Y has many wrong words that change the sense ('pulsa' for 'pusca', 'puniceū' for 'feniceū', 'agris' for 'areis', 'De ōes' for '⁊ oēs'), and its side-letters A/B/D/F do not match the printed G–N.
rows.gemini_note: Y introduces multiple sense-changing errors, such as reading 's̃putis' for 'v̄tutis', 'pulsa' for 'pusca', and 'Ar purgat' for 'Expurgat'.

rows.opus_note: Y misreads long s as 'f' throughout and drops whole phrases ('Magis exigas. Magis uitae longitudinem' and 'deus uoluntatem pro effectu coronabit ... quid utili-').
rows.gemini_note: Y omits a two-line passage in the right column ('uoluntatem pro effectu coronabit: & ita ut recte dixit Seneca: non refert quam diu sed quam bene uixeris) alioqui. i. aliter quid attinet. s. ad rem. i. quid utili') between 'deus' and 'tatis habet'.
